summary: Flathead County, MT ground lookout: a 1930 wooden L-4 cab on the Flathead NF, abandoned in the 1940s and listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed gone by firelookout.com and the Montana list; no source describes what remains today

events.note: Wooden L-4 cab listed at 10 feet (firelookout.com)
Source says 'Abandoned 1940s'; the year is the decade only

evidence.supports: built 1930 as a 10-foot wooden L-4 cab
Forest Lookouts page lists the site under the Flathead National Forest

notes_for_editor: Only two short listings and one Forest Lookouts page (legal location 32N-25W-1, no other detail) describe this site. Both searches returned topo maps and listings only. The 1930 date and the 1940s abandonment rest on one firelookout.com caption, and '10' ' is quoted as 10 feet because the source does not say whether it is height or width. Access is left out of facts because no source gives a level. The brief record (ground, gone, Flathead NF, coordinates) matches every source, so no corrections. No photo found.
